title: My 4 Go-To High-Protein Snacks
hook: If I do snack, I snack on something that's high in protein and low in carbs. Here are my four go-to snacks.
body: Number one, sardines, and number two, hard-boiled eggs, which I buy pre-packaged to make it easy. Number three, rotisserie chicken, it's $5 at Costco and it's already cooked. And number four, the protein cup from Chipotle, just a cup of chicken or steak, and the chicken one is about 180 calories and 32 grams of protein for about $7, so I would say that's the best fast food snack out there.
close: Save this for the next time you're out running around and you get hungry.
